chronology.notes: Lead-210 dating was done at Auburn Paleoenvironmental Lab, Auburn University, AL, USA. Radiocarbon dating of charcoal was done National Ocean Sciences Accelerator Mass Spectrometry Facility (NOSAMS) of Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution. Radiocarbon date calibration was performed online with Calib 8.2. The age-depth model was created with bacon using the uncalibrated ages.

site.sitedescription: The lake's shore is either developed with residences or part of Lake Waccamaw State Park. Beyond the shoreline, the surrounding landscape is covered by forested wetlands. Lake Waccamaw is one of the largest Carolina Bays.
